ops.title: capt-hook test scoping + HOME sandbox shipped as b28312b5; pinned-caches never-scratch rule; shared-copy file-scoped ship sweeps foreign hunks
ops.body:
Shipped to main as `b28312b5` (2026-07-20), all three CI workflows green; full record in cc-notes `af7ed8d`. Release tag remains user-gated; getaway's hand-rolled CI HOME incantation drops only after a release ships this.

- `capt-hook test` scope: bare = hooks dir + declared packs; `--hooks DIR` = only that dir; plugin packs never (`CliState.discover(scope=...)`); dispatch keeps full discovery.
- HOME sandbox: scratch home rides `isolated_state_root`; `pinned_caches()` pins `XDG_CACHE_HOME`/`WN_DATA_DIR` to REAL locations before any HOME swap — NEVER scratch those (spaCy raises for uvx consumers, wn re-downloads 231MB). Replay drive sandboxed, session lookup on real HOME.
- **Shared-copy ship hazard (transferable):** a file-scoped `ccx vcs ship` sweeps in foreign hunks another session added to "your" files between review and ship — it happened here (their `test_dead_shebang` hardening, dependent on their uncommitted plugins.py, entered my commit and failed against upstream). Re-diff the ship set at ship time; the stripped hunk still rides in local commit `31d1cd3e` for the other session to ship with plugins.py.
- Ship-race replay: worktree cherry-pick onto origin/main worked again ([[concurrent-release-race-protocol]]); a reboot wiped /tmp mid-push but the commit survived in the shared object store — recover by `git push <sha>:main`, never redo the resolution. CHANGELOG trap: upstream releases consume `[Unreleased]`, so cherry-picked bullets can silently land inside a released section — re-home them.
